title: Poisonous Apple
description: Adds a rare poisonous apple that drops from leaves and poisons the player when eaten.
body:
![Poison Apple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1566015408e49dab8f369cd215d53beddd9500ac_0.webp)
**_## Features:
* **Poison Apple:** A new type of apple that inflicts a powerful poison effect when eaten!
* **Natural Drops:** There is a small chance of obtaining this apple when destroying tree leaves in Survival mode._**
You can craft it by combining a spider eye and an apple at the crafting table
![The Making of the Poison Apple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9ae261ad81df405431ab6a85cd2ac5dcf58e7b3.png)
